title: Anthropic says its workforce has become less junior and is spending more time in meetings | TechCrunch
summary: Notably, Anthropic is making fewer junior hires, with the proportion of junior-level employees in technical departments falling from 21% to 14% since early 2025, and the proportion of junior technical hires falling even more sharply, from 27% to 9%.
